details.draft_body:
Hi Mateo,

Summary of the Hartford gate kiosk incident from Monday, Aug 3:

- Start: gate kiosks went offline at the Hartford plant around 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan; the guard checked in trucks on a clipboard.
- Recovery: kiosk 1 was back by 11:03 AM (trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch). Both lanes were confirmed working as of 11:07 AM.
- Status-page access: your login was getting access denied on the status page. This is tracked separately under ticket INC-4821, which includes the screenshot. Gateway reconnect work is with Carrowmere Cloud.

Let me know if you need anything else.

Gideon

args.subject: Hartford gate kiosk outage, 3 August: summary
args.body:
Mateo,

Here is a summary of the Hartford gate kiosk incident on Monday 3 August.

Outage: At about 10:42 AM the gate kiosks went offline. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

Recovery: Kiosk 1 was back at 11:03 AM, and trailer 8836 was checked in. Both lanes were confirmed working as of 11:07 AM. Kiosk 2 was left powered on for the reconnect attempts.

Status page: Your login to the status page was denied. That access issue is tracked in ticket INC-4821, which has the screenshot.

[Gideon: add the time the status-page access was resolved. The incident room does not record it.]

Thanks,
Gideon Sato
Pemberline Systems
